title: Systems work with measurable operational and business impact.
summary: These cases focus on measurable outcomes: queue elimination, realtime data visibility, custom platform integrations, and compliance-conscious delivery.

cases.title: Automated Fundraiser Acknowledgment at Scale
cases.summary: Replaced manual outsourced thank-you workflows with automated browser execution for high-volume fundraiser pages.
cases.outcome: Achieved roughly 12x per-operator throughput and ran 72 concurrent automation instances to eliminate persistent backlog.
highlights: Removed recurring backlog despite large monthly fundraiser volume
Improved response-time enough to increase fundraiser chat engagement

cases.title: Realtime Fundraiser Creation + Donation Signal Pipeline
cases.summary: Built an app workflow that captured fundraiser lifecycle and donation events without waiting for delayed batch files.
cases.outcome: Removed a 48-hour reporting lag and enabled immediate context for teams supporting fundraisers in realtime.
highlights: One-click fundraiser creation path integrated with Meta APIs
Immediate donation visibility instead of delayed CSV ingestion

cases.title: Custom Substack Publishing Pipeline in Rust
cases.summary: Built a Rust monorepo platform that connected CMS events, queued workers, and publishing automation for Substack-oriented content operations.
cases.outcome: Shipped a deterministic automation chain from Directus webhooks through queued workers to publishing actions.
highlights: Webhook event typing with collection/operation routing
Queue-driven processing and custom Substack integration
